title: Submitted
blurb: The request was raised, validated and priced.

title: Approved
blurb: Jira holds the approval. The portal only asks.

title: Blueprint
blurb: A certified recipe exists for every component. The agent proves one where none did.

title: Terraform selected
blurb: The signed handoff reaches the orchestrator, which picks the module from the certified blueprint.

title: Terraform plan
blurb: What would be built, worked out before anything is.

title: Security and policy
blurb: OPA re-checks the request and the plan is scanned, at execution rather than on the word of the form.

title: Provision
blurb: Terraform applies. This is the first step that creates anything.
detail: Terraform apply failed for oci-instance: the service limit for VM.Standard.E4.Flex in me-dubai-1 has been reached.

title: Verify
blurb: The machines report what actually started, and are checked against what was asked for.
